This patch implements a fan control safety watchdog
authors of userspace fan control scripts.

column2: the equivalent action of a ""fan enable""

column1: command is executed.  The watchdog timer is reset at every reception of a
fan control command that could change the state of the fan itself.
This command is meant to be used by userspace fan control daemons
sure the fan is never left set to an unsafe level because of userspace
Users of the X31/X40/X41 ""speed"" command are on their own
implementation of ""speed"" is just too incomplete to be used safely
anyway.  Better to never use it
column2: and just use the ""level"" command instead.

column1: The watchdog is programmed using echo ""watchdog <number>"" > fan
number is the number of seconds to wait before doing an ""enable""
